buy_label.description: Buy the label for a rate you were quoted and get back the file to print and the tracking number to send the customer. This charges the Shippo account.

parameters.description: Which quoted rate to buy: 32 letters and numbers, from a 'Rate ID' in 'Get shipping rates'. Wire in its 'cheapest' or 'fastest' to pick one without sorting the list yourself.

messages.description: Anything Shippo or the carrier wanted to say about this: a carrier that did not answer in time, a service that is not enabled. Present even when the step succeeded.

qr_code_url.description: Link to a QR code for label-free drop-off, where the carrier offers it.

status.description: 'SUCCESS' when the label is ready. 'REFUNDED', 'REFUNDPENDING' and 'REFUNDREJECTED' describe a label that has been sent back.

tracking_number.description: The carrier's tracking number for this parcel.

create_customs_form.description: Declare what is in a parcel crossing a border. Pass the ID it hands back into 'Get shipping rates' as the customs form, and the label is printed with it.

parameters.description: One entry per kind of item. Each needs a plain-words description, how many, what they weigh and are worth together, and the two-letter country where they were made.
parameters.name: items

description.description: What the item is, in plain words a customs officer will understand: 'cotton t-shirts', not 'SKU-4471'.

hs_code.description: Harmonised System tariff code. Some carriers and destinations require it.

mass_unit.description: Unit of that weight: lb, oz, kg or g.

net_weight.description: What all of them weigh together.

origin_country.description: Two-letter code for where the item was made, e.g. 'US'. Where it was made, not where it is being sent from.

quantity.description: How many of this item are in the parcel.

sku_code.description: Your SKU. Some carriers require it.

value_amount.description: What all of them are worth together.

parameters.description: How customs should treat the contents.
parameters.name: contents_type

parameters.description: Required only when the kind of goods is 'Something else'. Customs will not accept 'other' on its own.
parameters.name: contents_explanation

parameters.description: What customs should do when the parcel cannot be delivered. Returning it costs money; abandoning it loses the goods.
parameters.name: non_delivery_option

parameters.description: Name of the person taking responsibility for this declaration being true. It is printed on the form.
parameters.name: certify_signer

parameters.description: Who settles duty and tax at the border. Leave blank for the carrier's default, which is normally the recipient.
parameters.name: incoterm

options.label: DDU: the recipient pays duty and tax
DDP: I pay duty and tax
DAP: delivered at place, recipient pays duty

parameters.description: Only for shipments leaving the United States. Almost every ordinary parcel is the first option. Leave blank when not shipping from the US.
parameters.name: eel_pfc

options.label: NOEEI 30.37(a): under $2,500 per item (the usual one)
NOEEI 30.37(f): shipment to a US territory
AES ITN: filed with AES (needs the ITN number)

parameters.description: The filing number, required only when the exemption above is 'AES ITN'.
parameters.name: aes_itn

parameters.description: Your invoice number for these goods, if you have one.
parameters.name: invoice

parameters.description: Your own note against this form, up to 100 characters.
parameters.name: metadata
